python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

f5 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0005.png').convert('RGB'))

# Find table in F5
# Table legs: brown vertical bars
# Let's search columns x in 340..420, rows 290..340
# What colors are present that look like brown wood?
wood_pixels = (f5[:, :, 0] > 70) & (f5[:, :, 0] < 150) & (f5[:, :, 1] > 35) & (f5[:, :, 1] < 80) & (f5[:, :, 2] < 40)
# exclude plant pots
# plant pots are terracotta: red > 120, green ~ 60..100
# let's see where wood_pixels are:
y_w, x_w = np.where(wood_pixels)
print('All wood pixels count:', len(y_w))
for y, x in zip(y_w[::100], x_w[::100]):
    print(f'({x}, {y}): {f5[y, x]}')
"
